payment_settings.title: Payment Settings
payment_settings.name: Name
payment_settings.upload_hint: Upload a key/cert file or paste text below
payment_settings.help_wechat_app_id: The AppID linked to WeChat Pay. Find it in the WeChat Pay merchant platform product center or AppID account management.
payment_settings.help_mch_id: The WeChat Pay merchant ID. Find it in the merchant platform account center.
payment_settings.help_merchant_serial_no: The merchant API certificate serial number used for request signing. Find it under API security/API certificate.
payment_settings.help_api_v3_key: The API v3 key is a 32-character string configured in the merchant platform. Enter it directly; no file upload is needed.
payment_settings.help_merchant_private_key_pem: The merchant private key is the full apiclient_key.pem content generated with the merchant API certificate, not a 32-byte string.
payment_settings.help_wechatpay_public_key_id: The WeChat Pay public key ID usually starts with PUB_KEY_ID_. It is paired with the public key and must match callback header Wechatpay-Serial.
payment_settings.help_wechatpay_public_key_pem: The WeChat Pay public key verifies callback signatures. Paste the public key PEM text, not the merchant private key.
payment_settings.help_wechat_api_base_url: WeChat Pay API base URL. Default is https://api.mch.weixin.qq.com and usually does not need changes.
payment_settings.help_alipay_app_id: The Alipay Open Platform application AppID. Find it in the application details page.
payment_settings.help_app_private_key_pem: The Alipay app private key is your RSA2 private key PEM used for request signing.
payment_settings.help_alipay_public_key_pem: The Alipay public key verifies async notifications. Find it in the app signature settings.
payment_settings.help_alipay_gateway_url: Alipay gateway URL. Production default is https://openapi.alipay.com/gateway.do.
payment_settings.help_seller_id: Seller ID is the payee Alipay PID. Optional; when set, callbacks validate seller_id.

storage_channels.title: Storage Channels
storage_channels.name: Channel Name
storage_channels.help_aliyun_oss: Aliyun OSS only needs endpoint, bucket and access keys. The public base URL is generated as https://{bucket}.{endpoint}; storage class and object permission are sent as upload headers.
storage_channels.help_cloudflare_r2: Cloudflare R2 Endpoint is the S3 upload API. The client access URL prefix is used to build the public latest.json URL; use an R2 custom domain, an r2.dev public URL, or a public prefix with a path such as https://apphub.1postpro.com/apphub.
